body: Many of today's applications push graphics boards—not to mention mainboards and CPUs—to their physical limits. Especially the current generation of games demands everything a PC can deliver, making adequate cooling for your GPU and CPU absolutely vital. The Mystify H2O 2010 by TerraTec Electronic fills the bill perfectly here. The name stands for a high-end cooling system for your processor and graphics board, available now. This powerful water cooling system will keep you from "smoking" your hardware, even under the most extreme loads. It really comes into its own for overclocking or other tuning measures that exceed the capacity of normal air cooling. And the nice thing about it: you can't hear it! Mystify H2O 2010 not only reliably cools your hardware, it's also virtually silent. And the system is absolutely maintenance-free. The Mystify H2O 2010 is based on professional technology created by one of the leading developers of PC cooling systems: Innovatek. The complete kit contains everything necessary to install the system in your PC, from the water coolers for processor and graphics board to the necessary tubing and connectors and the powerful Eheim pump. Download Press Release, Word 6.0 Format.
